testcase.name: Scenario: Accept a custom annotation scale: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1003:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Accept a custom annotation scale ✔ Given an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a copied view representation is active with annotation scale Auto ✔ When the user opens the active view's Annotation Scale submenu ✔ And the user chooses Custom ✔ And the user replaces the scale with "3:2" ✔ And the user confirms the dialog ✔ And the user reopens the active view's Annotation Scale submenu ✔ Then Custom is checked ✔ And the Custom entry displays the equivalent decimal value 1.50 ✔ When the user selects Auto ✔ Then the annotation scale submenu closes
